name: Moonlight Sonata
source:
A country torn by war. Adventurer Rian walks around it earning his living with swordsmanship skills. He meets a mysterious girl Lilu. What's hidden in her past and what adventures await them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一個被戰爭撕裂的國家。冒險者里安在各地遊蕩，靠劍術謀生。他遇到了一個神秘的女孩莉露。她的過去隱藏著什麼？什麼樣的冒險在等待著他們？

［出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]］
